note: Every floor of every building (WORLD_MAP WLD-050 to WLD-053, F-BLD-INSIDE level 3, ADR-0021). Heights in metres: the ground floor stands at 0.2 with its ceiling at 3.2; floor f above it stands at 3f + 0.4 under a 0.2 slab, so the top ceiling meets the roof at floors x 3 + 0.4, the height the building has from outside. 'stair' is the switchback stair every building of two or more storeys has (two flights a storey, a spine wall between them, a landing at each end); 'lift_from_floors' gives a lift as well. 'uses' says what each upper floor is for, by the building's kind or special name (the first floor first; the last one repeats), and 'move' which of the residents' places go upstairs. Tools/worldgen/add_storeys_01.py places the stairs, lifts and upstairs places in the block files from these. All values are [ASSUMPTION] until tuned.
